pages.html:

Our Story

From Naples to Riverside

In 1978, Nonna Lucia Bianchi stepped off a ship in New Jersey with a suitcase full of recipes passed down from her mother and grandmother in Naples. She and her husband Salvatore opened a tiny four-table trattoria on Vine Street, cooking the dishes of their childhood for anyone who walked through the door.

Nearly fifty years later, La Famiglia Trattoria is still run by the same family. Lucia's grandson Marco now leads the kitchen, but the sauce still simmers for six hours, the pasta is still rolled by hand, and every guest is still greeted like family.

What began as a single room with checkered tablecloths has grown into a beloved neighborhood institution — but the heart of it has never changed: good food, shared slowly, with people you love.

What We Believe

🍝

Tradition

Every recipe on our menu traces back to a family notebook. We cook the way our grandparents taught us, with no shortcuts.

🌿

Freshness

We shop local markets daily and make our pasta, bread and desserts in-house, so everything on your plate is made that morning.

🤝

Hospitality

Whether it's your first visit or your fiftieth, you'll be welcomed like family and sent home with a full stomach and a warm heart.

The People Behind the Kitchen

Marco Bianchi

Head Chef & Grandson of the Founder

Trained in Bologna before returning home, Marco keeps Nonna Lucia's recipes alive while adding his own seasonal touches.

Isabella Bianchi

Restaurant Manager

Marco's sister Isabella runs the front of house, making sure every guest feels like they've just walked into her own living room.

Lucia Bianchi

Founder & Resident Nonna

Now in her 80s, Lucia still visits every Sunday to taste the sauce and remind the kitchen staff to add a little more basil.

Visit Us

We'd love to welcome you to our table. Find us in the heart of Riverside, just two blocks from the river walk.

Visit Us

We'd love to welcome you to our table. Find us in the heart of Riverside, just two blocks from the river walk.
